title: Radiate
description: A short word in heavy Geist on white, its outline echoed outward in evenly spaced black lines, after Lance Wyman's Mexico 68 logotype. The lines are true offset curves of the letters, solved exactly from the glyph outlines, so the echoes of neighbouring letters meet in clean creases. The pointer is a magnet that pinches the field toward it, bunching the lines into op-art moiré on one side and spreading them on the other. A click sends one wave out through the lines, and where it leaves the field it carries a ring away with it.
intent: Translate Wyman's radiating parallel lines (https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/iconic-design-official-poster-for-the-mexico-1968-olympic-games) into a live field: exact offset curves of real type, pulled by the hand.
